stem:
Tanya fills a metal bowl with ice cubes from the freezer on a humid day. Soon, small water droplets form on the outside of the bowl.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Water vapour from the air cools on the cold bowl and turns into liquid droplets by condensation.
The outside droplets come from water vapour in the surrounding air, not from ice leaking through the metal.
Water vapour turns into those outside droplets by evaporation.

teacher.key_rationale: Outside droplets form when air vapour condenses on the cold bowl. They come from surrounding air. Calling that change evaporation is the false statement.
